§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
Hold one Artificial Stellar Confinement Core controller; it is not consumed. It runs native GT fusion recipes in fixed 20-second cycles, retaining their material inputs and outputs while reducing power according to original recipe duration.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
Build it through the loom. Provide sufficient energy, helium-3, fusion inputs and output space at the main working ports. Additional helium plasma needs its own outlet too. This machine consumes EU; it is not a free-energy generator.
